name: cheapest-domains
description: Research domain names and compare registration, renewal and estimated costs across selected registrars. Check suggested names by default and show their availability status with read-only tools.

interface.shortDescription: Find domain names you can afford to keep.
interface.longDescription: Use your assistant to suggest names, compare fresh renewal prices across selected registrars, estimate supported ownership costs, and check exact-name availability and premium status. Keep source dates and unknown results explicit. Purchase directly at your registrar. Optional Cloudflare Radar data measures DNS popularity, not Google search competition.
defaultPrompt: Suggest domain names for my project with low annual renewals.
Compare current .com renewal prices across registrars.
Find domain extensions under $15 per year to renew.
